data.excerpt: Your first post. Replace this with your own content.

children.text: Bea co-hosts a trivia-format podcast about birds of the world.
Yusuf cares for the tropical bird collection at the city zoo.
Samuel researches urban bird habitats and backyard conservation.
Ingrid curates the raptor aviary at the regional nature center.
Martin specializes in habitat protection law and wildlife photography disputes.
Rosalind helps fellow birders budget for their next big trip.
Felix writes sketches for HeronCon's annual bird-themed improv show.
Wanda has banded thousands of shorebirds at coastal monitoring stations.
Gregory hosts a podcast about backyard birding for total beginners.
Nadia tracks migratory routes using satellite tags and citizen-science reports.
Oscar has trained raptors for educational programs for over fifteen years.
Talia leads HeronCon's dawn birding walks and can identify a warbler by call alone.
Desmond's photos of migrating shorebirds have appeared in three nature calendars.
Priya spends her summers tagging songbirds in the marshlands surrounding HeronCon's host city.

“I build things for the internet, I write, and I am more enthusiastic about paleontology than a non-paleontologist adult should be. I hail from the beautiful town of New Orleans, Louisiana and now live in the beautiful town of Oakland, California.”
Marcus leads HeronCon's birding walks every year.
About Jane
Jane has studied shoebill storks for over a decade.
